_about: The region registry (PLAN/phases/PHASE-10.md): every AOI-dependent behaviour reads its extent from here. The console (sim/regions.ts) and the backend (backend/regions.py) share this file. It sits inside frontDemo/ because a Vercel build rooted there cannot import from outside it. Boxes are [west, south, east, north], degrees. `aoi` decides which zone a scene or run belongs to; `landmask` is the coast bundled into the page for scenarios built before anything loads (scripts/build_landmask.py); `aisFootprint` is the measured scene footprint AIS is clipped to (buffered in backend/ingest/ais/clip.py). `infrastructure` and `windGate` are surfaced as caveats on every evidence card in the zone.

regions.label: Gulf of Mexico
regions.forcing: ERA5 wind and CMEMS global currents

infrastructure.note: No verified installation dataset is loaded for the Gulf of Mexico. The platform groups in the authored scenes are placed by hand, so a real installation missing from them would push its share of a score onto vessels.

windGate.note: The 3 and 10-12 m/s wind-gate bounds come from studies in other basins (Espedal 1999); they are used here, not re-derived for the Gulf.

regions.label: Gulf of Kutch
regions.ais: simulated (no free AIS outside US waters)

infrastructure.note: The Vadinar and Sikka moorings are placed from public descriptions; the SAR Fixed Infrastructure Dataset has not been verified for Indian waters, so a missing installation here would read as a vessel.

windGate.note: Monsoon wind climatology differs materially from the basins the 3 and 10-12 m/s bounds were derived in; they are unvalidated for the Gulf of Kutch.

regions.label: Mumbai High
regions.ais: simulated (no free AIS outside US waters)

infrastructure.note: The Mumbai High platform complexes are placed from public descriptions; the dense offshore field is not in any verified dataset here, so a missing platform would read as a vessel.

windGate.note: Monsoon wind climatology differs materially from the basins the 3 and 10-12 m/s bounds were derived in; they are unvalidated for Mumbai High.

regions.label: Chennai / Ennore
regions.ais: simulated (no free AIS outside US waters)

infrastructure.note: No installation dataset is loaded for the Chennai coast; the Kamarajar and Chennai port approaches are drawn from public charts, not a verified layer.

windGate.note: North-east monsoon winds over the Bay of Bengal are outside the conditions the 3 and 10-12 m/s bounds were derived in; they are unvalidated here.

regions.label: Paradip
regions.ais: simulated (no free AIS outside US waters)

infrastructure.note: The Paradip single point moorings are placed from public descriptions of the crude terminal; the SAR Fixed Infrastructure Dataset has not been verified for Indian waters.

windGate.note: The Bay of Bengal cyclone and monsoon regime is outside the conditions the 3 and 10-12 m/s bounds were derived in; they are unvalidated here.
